# Tarkov Quest Planner

> Free, account-free interactive quest map and quest tracker for Escape from Tarkov, in English and French. Fan site, not affiliated with Battlestate Games.

Tarkov Quest Planner shows the objectives of the selected quests as points on the map of each location, with the extracts, co-op extracts and transits. The user ticks quests off after a raid and the tool suggests the next ones. Progress is stored in the browser (localStorage), separately for each game mode: PvP, PvE and PvP Season. There is no account and no progress server. The interface is in English by default; French is one click away (language selector).

URL: https://tarkov.aprilox.fr/

## Features

- Quest objectives on the map: one colour per quest, one icon per objective type.
- Extracts, co-op extracts and transits of every map.
- Import of current quests from a screenshot (Character > Tasks menu): Ctrl+V or a photo from a phone, OCR read in the browser.
- Item search: the quests and hideout modules that need it, barters and crafts.
- Quest page: objectives, items to bring, prerequisites, rewards, wiki guide and photos.
- Kappa quests, PvE quests, PvP season quests.
- Team play with a "room": everyone keeps their own quests and sees their teammates' quests in read-only mode.

## Data

- Quests, objectives, maps and items: tarkov.dev API (https://tarkov.dev/).
- Detailed texts, guides and photos of the quests: Escape from Tarkov wiki (https://escapefromtarkov.fandom.com/wiki/Escape_from_Tarkov_Wiki).

## Résumé en français

Tarkov Quest Planner est une carte interactive et un suivi des quêtes d'Escape from Tarkov, gratuit et sans compte. Sélectionne tes quêtes en cours pour voir leurs objectifs et les sorties sur la map, coche-les en fin de raid et l'outil te propose la suite. La progression est enregistrée dans le navigateur, séparément pour chaque mode (PvP, PvE, PvP Saison). Données : tarkov.dev et wiki Escape from Tarkov. Site de fan non affilié à Battlestate Games.
